jobs.prompt: Create premium educational anatomical exercise illustration for DUMBBELL LYING TRICEPS EXTENSION, canonical0351, adult MALE. Reference artistic style and bench only; do NOT copy bench press mechanics. TWO equal side-by-side panels, white gutters generous margins, same person bench dumbbells camera scale and clothing. Near SIDE three-quarter view shows both arms and both dumbbells without merging. Lie SUPINE ALONG flat padded bench with head/upper back/pelvis supported, both feet flat on floor. Hold ONE dumbbell in each hand, NEUTRAL GRIP palms face each other, wrists straight. Left panel: arms extended upward over chest/shoulders, dumbbells separated shoulder-width, elbows softly extended. Right panel: bend ONLY elbows to lower dumbbells close to sides of FOREHEAD without contacting head; upper arms remain nearly VERTICAL in same position as left, elbows stay shoulder-width and do not flare or drop into bench press. Forearms tilt toward head, dumbbells near forehead, neutral wrist alignment. Keep upper arms fixed, neck neutral, pelvis on bench. Highlight TRICEPS on posterior upper arms RED only, no red biceps/chest/delts. Crisp detailed GRAYSCALE anatomical muscle contours on exposed arms/calves, realistic proportions, no flesh-colored photo. Fully opaque black sleeveless athletic top covering chest torso sides/back, knee-length shorts wrapping entire front sides back seat crotch with seams folds closed leg openings, shoes. No cutaway transparent clothing missing rear panels. White background soft shadows. Whole bench body weights inside each panel. No text labels numbers arrows logos. Correct hands gripping each shaft; do not add third dumbbell or arms.
jobs.inspectionNote: Elbow flexion/extension with upper arms nearly vertical, two dumbbells, supported head/pelvis and full opaque garments visible. Qualified neutral grip, triceps boundaries, bilateral consistency and forehead clearance review pending.
